name: direction-aware-tabs
blurb: Tabs with directional slide-in/out animations based on tab order.
description: Tab switcher where content slides in/out direction based on whether user clicked a tab before or after the current one. Spring-based transitions.
use_when: Tab interfaces where directional motion hints at data order (e.g., timeline or sequence).
avoid_when: Simple tab switching; directional animation adds complexity.
a11y: Tab buttons are keyboard-navigable. Content regions have proper ARIA labels and roles.
